page.overview:
Who is Atlas?

Atlas is a large, barrel-chested thug who wears dark brown boots and fingerless gloves, knee pads, and a necklace made of animal teeth and/or claws. He does not wear a shirt, revealing scars on his arms and chest. Atlas has light skin, short hair, and a mustache.

Atlas has a rowdy personality that makes everyone fear him. He is a troubled man that drinks from the morning and immediately gives hugs.

Atlas was a promising athlete in his youth, as he was able to go to college on a football scholarship. Sometime after this, he soon gained interest in combat sports, and took up learning wrestling and sambo. Unfortunately, his career was put to a screeching halt after being in a traffic accident and sustaining injuries that left him unable to participate in competitions. Unable to cope and at a loss of pride, he soon spiraled into a degenerate lifestyle of alcoholism and violence, which lead him to joining the Mad Gear Gang.

Atlas is slow-moving powerhouse who can take a lot of damage before going down. Using his trained body as a weapon, he fights with palm strikes, shoves, and grabs, and is also capable of blocking attacks.
